title: Trump: A Pilot Saw a UFO 4× Faster Than an F-22 🛸
description:
"Are aliens real? Have we been visited? Are we reverse engineering their technology?" 🛸

Newsmax's Rob Finnerty put the big question to President Trump in an exclusive White House interview. Trump says he wasn't much of a believer, even though he has friends who talk about nothing else. But, he says, "we see some pretty strange things."

He says he has met with five or six Air Force pilots, "solid people," not conspiracy theorists, who saw things while flying that they'd never seen before. In one case, he says, a pilot saw a round object, not an ideal shape for going fast, that went four times faster than an F-22. Trump asked if it could have been a comet. The pilot's answer: "It wasn't, sir." ✈️

Asked if he'll be the president who finally discloses the truth: "I'm looking," though he admits it's not high on his list. He also brings up Area 51 in Nevada and its "little rusting fence," and says: "We are releasing documents. We are releasing everything." 📂

These are the President's own accounts. The pilot encounters he describes haven't been independently confirmed.
